plugin_not_found: The plugin or this version was not found.
plugin_signature_invalid: The plugin package's signature could not be verified; it was not installed.
plugin_api_level: This plugin version does not work with this Crewhall version.
plugin_not_for_installation: This plugin is published for other organizations only.
plugin_permissions_mismatch: Only the permissions the plugin asks for can be granted.
plugin_permissions_changed: The new version asks for more permissions; you need to approve them.
plugin_unreachable: The plugin's server could not be reached.
plugin_disabled: This plugin is turned off for the organization.
plugin_offline_not_granted: This person has not allowed the plugin to work in the background.
marketplace_unreachable: The plugin marketplace could not be reached. Try again shortly.
plugin_link_invalid: This is not a plugin id or this marketplace's install link.
plugin_hosting_changed: This version changes how the plugin is hosted; uninstall it and install it again.
plugin_self_origin_required: This plugin runs on the organization's own server; enter its https address.
plugin_self_origin_invalid: The server address must be an https address without a path (e.g. https://wa.company.com).
plugin_self_unreachable: The plugin on your server could not be reached, or /.well-known/crewhall-plugin.json could not be read.
plugin_self_manifest_mismatch: The manifest on your server is not the one the marketplace signed (id, version, permissions or content).
plugin_user_not_linked: The plugin cannot notify this person: they have not opened it yet.
plugin_url_invalid: The notification link must open one of the plugin's own tabs.
